<b>Pokenabbins</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flying creatures with sharp proboscis.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pokenabbins fly from side to side and perform a short diagonal-only dash at Hornet when she approaches. After attacking, they return to their original flying behaviour.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pokenabbins have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Pokenabbins are primarily found in the [[Sands of Karak]]. Three of them can be found in the tall room directly above the entrance from the [[Blasted Steps]]. The others are located in the platforming areas to the east.
